name: Build a Fish Army
desc:
🐟 BUILD A FISH ARMY! 🏴‍☠️

Cast your rod… catch powerful fish… and turn them into the ultimate ocean army!
Place your fish fighters, start waves, and battle pirates, sea monsters, and legendary bosses!

🎣 FISH & COLLECT – Catch common, rare, exotic, and mythical fish
⚔️ PLACE YOUR ARMY – Build formations that destroy waves of enemies
🌊 START WAVES – Fight pirates, raiders, submarines, and more
💰 UPGRADE & EVOLVE – Power up your fish to unlock insane abilities
🏆 BECOME THE OCEAN’S LEADER – Build the strongest fish squad on the seas

Play with friends, grow your army, and conquer the waters!
Are you ready to command your fish?
